description: Test helper functions for creating Kubernetes Endpoint and EndpointSlice objects, and verifying create/update actions in fake clientsets, used in reconcilers tests.

methods.name: makeEndpointsArray
methods.description: Creates an array of runtime objects including Endpoints and EndpointSlice for given name, IPs, and ports.

methods.name: makeEndpoints
methods.description: Constructs a corev1 Endpoints object with specified IPs and ports.

methods.name: makeEndpointSlice
methods.description: Constructs a discoveryv1 EndpointSlice object with specified IPs and ports.

methods.name: verifyCreatesAndUpdates
methods.description: Verifies that the fake clientset performed expected create and update actions.
